style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean travel-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist white #FFFFFF, misty blue-grey #C9D3E0, carbon charcoal #26282E and one slate-blue accent #5B7CA6; neutral-cool lighting with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines and short labels; consistent rounded info chips and thin-line icons; matte hard-shell luggage rendering with stable product scale and placement; clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
